epics.title: v0.4 Scheduled transactions
epics.body:
Create, edit and run GnuCash scheduled transactions, today kept only as Residue. Parity with GnuCash 5.17's SchedXaction engine, Recurrence.cpp, gnc-exp-parser formulas, the Since Last Run instance model (`5.17:libgnucash/app-utils/gnc-sx-instance-model.c`), Schedule from transaction (`dialog-sx-from-trans.cpp`) and the loan assistant (`assistant-loan.cpp`). Design: `design/milestone4.md` "Scheduled transactions"; research: `design/notes/engine-scheduled-transactions.md`; API: `design/api/scheduled-transactions.md`.

Work (on branch `milestone-4`, one worktree branch per item):
- [ ] Formulas with variables and exact financial functions in core
- [ ] Scheduled transactions and template transactions in the core model and XML Backend
- [ ] Recurrence arithmetic ported from Recurrence.cpp; next instance
- [ ] Instance model: due instances, amounts, creating transactions, advancing schedules
- [ ] `scheduledTransaction.*` CRUD and occurrences
- [ ] Since Last Run: proposal, apply, discard
- [ ] fromTransaction and loan

epics.title: v0.4 Budgets
epics.body:
Create and edit GnuCash budgets (amounts and notes per account and period), estimate them from history and handle natural signs, matching GnuCash 5.17 (`5.17:libgnucash/engine/gnc-budget.cpp`, `ScrubBudget.c`, the estimate dialog in `gnc-plugin-page-budget.cpp:955-1092`). Today budgets are Residue: kept byte for byte but not editable. Design: `design/milestone4.md` "Budgets"; research: `design/notes/engine-budgets.md`; API: `design/api/budgets.md`.

Work:
- [ ] Budgets and recurrences in the core model and XML Backend
- [ ] Budget operations: create, update, copy, delete, amounts, notes, natural signs, periods, actuals
- [ ] Estimate from history
- [ ] `budget.*` methods

epics.title: v0.4 Budget and forecast reports
epics.body:
Translate GnuCash 5.17's budget and forecast reports into Rhai on the v0.2 report engine: Budget Report, Budget Balance Sheet, Budget Income Statement (and Budget Profit & Loss), Budget Flow, Budget Chart, the Future Scheduled Transactions Summary and Balance Forecast. Sources and GUIDs: `design/milestone4.md` "Reports"; library gaps: `design/notes/engine-budgets.md` §4.11. Expected results from `test-budget.scm` and hand-worked cases (no Guile).

Work:
- [ ] Report library: budget reads, SX cash flow, acct-table report_budget/get_balance_fn, make_date_interval_list, budget/complex-boolean/callback options
- [ ] Budget Report
- [ ] Budget Balance Sheet, Budget Income Statement, Budget P&L
- [ ] Budget Flow, Budget Chart
- [ ] Future Scheduled Transactions Summary, Balance Forecast

epics.title: v0.4 SQLite books
epics.body:
Open, edit and save SQLite GnuCash books without loss, with GnuCash's `gnclock` lock, `.log` journal and ISO-dates Book feature; SQL books are refused outright today. Stricter than GnuCash: opening never writes, schemas are never upgraded, saves are one checked SQL transaction at `book.save`. Design: `design/milestone4.md` "SQLite books", `design/sql-fidelity.md`; research: `design/notes/sql-backend.md`.

Work:
- [ ] Backend seam in red-ale-service, XML behind it, no byte changes
- [ ] red-ale-sql: schema, versions check, reading every modelled table (read-only open)
- [ ] Lock, writing and the checked save
- [ ] Journal, backups, book.create format, oracle-built SQLite fixtures, round-trip and oracle tests
